analysis.reasonEn: Previous wait-and-see stance maintained, same decision today. RSI at 51.9 continues consolidation in neutral zone, MACD histogram at 0.9875 worsening from 1.6758 five days ago, indicating slowing momentum. Failed to sustain Higher Low pattern recovery as 5-day low of $42.16 did not hold above 20-day low of $31.81. Volume at 0.81x indicates contraction and lack of directional conviction. Facing resistance from SMA5 at $45.11 and EMA50 at $43.98. Current price at 29.7% of 52-week range near lows.
